decisions.chief_resolution: Monomaterial unpainted plastics (e.g., pure polypropylene) with optimized structural ribbing. This satisfies Circularity's need for high-purity recycling (d) and M&D's lightweighting (t), while engineering design can compensate for impact resistance (a) without needing thick virgin ABS/PC or heavy metal.
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of high-impact post-consumer recycled polypropylene resins that meet both UL 94 flame retardancy standards and minimum mechanical impact requirements.

decisions.chief_resolution: Reversible mechanical fasteners (screws, clips) using standardized metal screws directly into reinforced plastic bosses. This ensures compliance with Annex I (b) ease of repair and maintenance (Page 79) and Annex I (d) ease of disassembly for recycling (Page 79).
decisions.design_action: Review international repairability standards (such as EN 45554) to identify the optimal screw head types and torque specs that allow disassembly with commonly available household tools.

decisions.chief_resolution: Modular brushless DC motor with mechanically secured, easily separable magnets. Under the priority hierarchy, regulatory compliance is key. ESPR Annex I (g) energy efficiency and (a) durability strongly favor BLDC motors over brushed motors. To satisfy Circularity and M&D's recycling concerns, the BLDC motor must use mechanically secured, non-glued magnets to allow easy separation of rare-earth elements at end-of-life, satisfying Annex I (d) and (e).
decisions.design_action: Investigate supplier capabilities for brushless DC motors that feature mechanically clamped magnets instead of adhesive bonding to confirm supply chain viability.

decisions.chief_resolution: Passive cooling via structural ventilation slots and lightweight aluminum heat sinks. A dedicated active cooling fan increases spatial volume, weight, and material footprint, which conflicts with lightweight design (Annex I (t), Page 80) and increases resource consumption. Passive cooling, combined with a modular, high-efficiency BLDC motor (which generates less heat), is engineering-feasible and satisfies Annex I (t) and (f) by avoiding complex active components and substances of concern (like potted compounds).
decisions.design_action: Perform a literature and patent search on passive heat sink geometries for high-power household appliances to identify designs that maximize natural convection without active airflow.

decisions.chief_resolution: Highly modular architecture with standardized, swappable sub-assemblies and clear material coding. Regulatory compliance with ESPR Annex I (b) ease of repair and maintenance (Page 79) and (c) ease of upgrading/remanufacturing (Page 79) is non-negotiable. A monolithic design would lead to premature obsolescence when a single component fails, directly violating the ESPR's core circularity mandates.
decisions.design_action: Consult with regional waste management and recycling facilities to confirm that the proposed sub-assembly snap-fit dimensions allow automated sorting and manual disassembly within target times.

espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (f), page 9: minimization of substances of concern which determine the possibility for reuse or recovery
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (r), page 80: amounts of waste generated, including hazardous waste

decisions.chief_resolution: Mains-powered corded design with integrated cord reel and no chemical battery. Eliminating the battery completely avoids the use of substances of concern (Annex I (f), Page 9), prevents hazardous waste generation (Annex I (r), Page 80), and avoids battery degradation which limits the product's technical lifetime (Annex I (a), Page 79). While cordless offers convenience, a corded design ensures consistent functional performance (Annex I (s)) and significantly reduces the product's lifecycle environmental and carbon footprint (Annex I (m), (n)).
decisions.design_action: Conduct a regulatory compliance review of cord reel safety standards (e.g., IEC 60335-2-2) to identify maximum allowable spring tension and thermal cut-out requirements.
